title: Being framed for "stealing"
content: So apparently I registered for a Yugioh tournament in a place that I usually go to. There was a guy who apparently was so excited to play Yugioh, but I corrected him because he only had Pokemon cards with him. Don't know why but his cards were laminated. Anyways, I was going to get ready to play but I accidentally left my deck in the parking lot. So I went outside, when all of a sudden, a strange metallic water bottle attached to my body when I tried to squeeze through from an open sedan door. That water bottle belonged to an Indian girl who was the owner of the sedan. Anyways, I noticed that she began to chase me. For some reason, I was being false framed. She chased me inside a multi story department store. I was running all over the department store, but I always ended up going through a strange perfume mist. I went through the back of the store (changing room) area. The mist came from the woman's changing room (first encounter with the mist). I went through the elevator and I ended up in the second floor. There I noticed a group of people who pushed me to the elevator and somehow we went down to the basement. I ran up the staircase. Somehow, I was always in the verge of being catched. As I tried to go up the elevator again, I somehow ended up in the basement once again. In the heat of the moment, in the second time I ended up in the basement, I encountered the strange perfume mist again. Somehow my body felt heavier than usual. I was struggling to breathe and I felt tired. I never was caught for the water bottle, but while I struggled to go up the second time from the basement, I just woke up from the dream completely. Here is the strange part of the dream, I never played besides a department store before. I don't know why, but normally when I have played Yugioh in Mall World, it was in the woods area. It's as if I wasn't supposed to walk into the parking lot to my car in order to grab my deck. Now why my fun dream became a chase dream, I never understand that.
